_note: Owner's manual picks for the Salient column, applied last. {work_id: {why_en, why_zh}} adds; {work_id: null} removes.

kshitij-parashar--who-ar-you.why_en: A character floats above your head that everyone in the room can see except you.
kshitij-parashar--who-ar-you.why_zh: 一个角色悬在你头顶，房间里所有人都看得见，唯独你自己看不见。

markus-lanxinger--postmark.why_en: A postcard on the fridge speaks only while you look at it, and waits quietly when you look away.
markus-lanxinger--postmark.why_zh: 贴在冰箱上的明信片，只有你看着它时才开口说话，移开视线它就安静地等着。

calvin-dong--pic-seeker.why_en: A photo cuts a hole in the room, and the next player has to find the real spot that fills it.
calvin-dong--pic-seeker.why_zh: 一张照片在房间里挖出一个洞，下一位玩家要找到能把它补上的真实位置。

harry-banda--memory-grid.why_en: You remember the path by walking it on the real floor instead of tapping it.
harry-banda--memory-grid.why_zh: 记住的路线要用双脚在真实地板上走出来，而不是用手指点出来。

pieter-siekerman--transitview.why_en: You see the bus coming around the corner while a building still hides it.
pieter-siekerman--transitview.why_zh: 公交车还被楼挡着，你已经能看见它从拐角开过来。

awu-chen--wake-them-up.why_en: The objects in a room tell the dreams of the person who used to live with them.
awu-chen--wake-them-up.why_zh: 房间里的物件替不在场的主人讲出他们的梦。

hart-woolery--tech-deck-specs.why_en: Two fingers become a skater riding a tiny skatepark on a café table.
hart-woolery--tech-deck-specs.why_zh: 两根手指变成滑板手，在咖啡桌上的迷你滑板场里滑行。

imogen-heap--sound-space-specs.why_en: The air around her body becomes a loop station she plays with her hands and voice.
imogen-heap--sound-space-specs.why_zh: 她身体周围的空气变成一台循环录音机，用手和声音来演奏。

vincent-guigui--lyrics-everywhere.why_en: A song's lyrics turn up in the world: on a rabbit's sign, a plane's banner, and in speech bubbles over passers-by.
vincent-guigui--lyrics-everywhere.why_zh: 歌词出现在真实世界里：兔子举的牌子上、飞机拖的横幅上，还有路人头顶的对话气泡里。
